title: Clear My Name Slow Burn
style: 84 bpm, slow burn blues rock, dirty Telecaster guitar, Hammond B3 organ, upright bass, brushed snare drums, smoky male blues lead, female smoky harmony, late night roadhouse, dynamic build
lyrics:
[Intro - dirty Telecaster slow burn, Hammond organ swell]
Clear my name — slow burn
The operator takes the turn
No running, no spin
Just the truth, walking in

[Verse 1 - Male blues lead, smoky]
They said the operator broke it, said the operator slipped
Didn't know the half of it, didn't know the script
I took the call, I took the swing, I took the cold report
Didn't dodge a single line, didn't fold the sport
Thirty eight gig went dark, that one's on me
Hawkeye saw it happen, the witness on the tree

[Pre-Chorus - female backing, smoky harmony]
Clear my name, slow burn
Not in a hurry, just in turn
No press release, no high horse ride
Just the operator with nothing left to hide

[Chorus - blues-rock, organ + tele]
Clear my name — slow burn
Clear my name — it's my turn
Not a brag, not a fight
Just the record getting right
Clear my name — slow burn
Three thirty six — every lesson earned
The operator owns the day
The operator finds the way

[Verse 2 - Male, deeper drawl]
Wasn't Pete, wasn't Brandon, wasn't La Banda's fault
Wasn't Mish Mash, wasn't Hawkeye, wasn't anyone vault
It was the operator's hand and the operator's call
And the operator's hand is the one that built it all
So I take the heat, I take the chair
I take the silence and the staring
Thirty eight gig came home, the workshop is whole
Clear my name — slow burn — the truth is the goal

[Bridge - tele solo, organ holding chord]
No speeches. No defense. No deflection.
Just the work and the record and the slow correction.
Three thirty six. The operator stands.
Clear name. Steady hands.

[Final Chorus - full band swell]
Clear my name — slow burn
Clear my name — the lesson learned
No brag, no flex, no fight
Just the record getting right
Clear my name — slow burn
Three thirty six — the truth returned
The operator stands the day
The operator walks away clean

[Outro - tele fade, organ sustain]
Clear my name... slow burn...
Three thirty six... it's my turn...
The operator types... the operator stays...
Clear my name... clean days.
